description:
Mumbai, Maharashtra
  
Job Summary
  
  

JAGIL is in the process of establishing a robust IT infrastructure framework with infrastructure components and services split across two service providers – AzTech and JPL. To ensure seamless setup, governance, and operational continuity, JAGIL requires an experienced IT TOM Consultant to independently design and implement the necessary processes, technical architectures, and coordination frameworks across both entities. This is a hands\-on, outcome\-driven engagement requiring a self\-starter who can navigate a dynamic multi\-vendor environment and deliver structured outcomes within a 6\-month window.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

PI (Continual Process Improvement) Design, document, and implement CPI processes tailored to JAGIL\\'s infrastructure landscape. Identify process gaps across AzTech and JPL delivery models and recommend improvements. Establish metrics, KPIs, and review cadences to track process maturity over time. Drive adoption of standardised operating procedures across both service providers. 2\. InfoSec Process Design \& Governance Define and operationalize Information Security processes aligned with industry standards (ISO 27001, NIST, or equivalent). Conduct risk assessments on existing and proposed infrastructure components across both service providers. Establish InfoSec controls, access management policies, and incident response procedures. Coordinate with AzTech and JPL to ensure InfoSec compliance across all infrastructure touchpoints. 3\. Infrastructure Technical Design Create comprehensive process and technical design documentation for the infrastructure setup across JAGIL, AzTech, and JPL. Define integration points, handoff protocols, and responsibility matrices (RACI) between the two service providers. Ensure technical designs are scalable, secure, and aligned with JAGIL\\'s business objectives. Validate infrastructure configurations and propose optimisations as needed. 4\. Stakeholder Coordination \& Governance Act as the primary coordinator between JAGIL, AzTech, and JPL stakeholders on all infrastructure and process matters. Independently manage tasks with minimal supervision while maintaining clear communication with all parties. Facilitate governance meetings, track action items, and escalate risks proactively. Adapt swiftly to dynamic task requirements as the engagement evolves.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

8\+ years of overall IT experience with a strong background in infrastructure management and IT operations. Demonstrated experience in CPI / IT process design and implementation in a multi\-vendor environment. Hands\-on expertise in Information Security frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or similar). Strong technical acumen across infrastructure domains: networking, cloud, servers, storage, and end\-user computing. Experience working with outsourced / managed service providers and managing SLAs. Proven ability to create technical design documents, SOPs, and governance frameworks independently. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills – ability to interface with both technical and business audiences.
  
  

Other Requirements
  
  

Prior experience in financial services, BFSI, or enterprise infrastructure environments. Familiarity with ITIL v4 framework and service management best practices. Relevant certifications: ITIL, CISM, CISSP, Azure/AWS, or equivalent. Experience managing transitions or new infrastructure setups in a greenfield/brownfield context. \*Job Summary\*

We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with 2\+ years of experience in building web\-based applications, preferably in the IoT domain. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Angular and experience working with real\-time data, REST APIs, and IoT communication protocols. You will be responsible for developing intuitive dashboards and interfaces that enable seamless monitoring and management of IoT devices.

\*Key Responsibilities\*

Design, develop, and maintain user\-friendly web interfaces for IoT applications using Angular.

Build and maintain real\-time dashboards to monitor, control, and analyze IoT device data.

Implement real\-time data updates using MQTT and WebSockets.

Integrate frontend applications with backend services using RESTful APIs (HTTP/HTTPS).

Fetch, display, and manage live and historical IoT data efficiently.

Collaborate with backend, hardware, and IoT teams to ensure smooth data flow and device communication.

Ensure security, performance, and scalability of the web platform.

Optimize applications for responsiveness and cross\-browser compatibility.

Troubleshoot, debug, and enhance existing applications.

\*Required Skills \& Qualifications\*

\*Mandatory:\*

Minimum 2 years of experience in frontend development

Strong expertise in Angular (latest versions preferred)

Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript

\*IoT \& Communication Protocols:\*

Working knowledge of MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, WebSockets

Understanding of real\-time data handling

\*API \& Security:\*

Experience with RESTful APIs

Knowledge of JSON, JWT authentication

\*Additional Skills (Preferred):\*

Experience in IoT platforms or industrial dashboards

Familiarity with data visualization libraries

Basic understanding of cloud services and IoT architectures

Knowledge of role\-based access control and secure authentication

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi is seeking a highly motivated candidate for Senior Angular developer in Wholesale Credit Risk Technology team that serves Institutional Credit Management (ICM). We are looking for a talented professional with a solid technical acumen to partner with onshore and offshore teams and design and deliver innovative technology solution for the front office, Credit Risk Business. The candidate will be a core member of the technology team responsible implementing projects based on Angular, Micro Frontend architecture, Typescript and using latest technologies. * Research and resolve complex issues, escalating as appropriate.

* Hands on development experience working on Micro Frontends using Angular and integration with REST APIs
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes and other containerized platforms.
* Ability to effectively interact, collaborate with development team
* Ability to effectively communicate development progress to the Project Lead
* Work with developers onshore, offshore and matrix teams to implement a business solution
* Investigate possible bug scenarios and production support issues
* Experience developing application in Financial Services industry is preferred

* 8\+years of relevant experience
* Experience in systems analysis and programming of software applications
* Experience in managing and implementing successful projects
* Working knowledge of consulting/project management techniques/methods
* Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements

  

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

We are looking forward to hire SAP Fiori Professionals in the following areas :
  
  

**Job description:**  

**Position Title:** SAP FIORI Lead
  
  

**Experience and Qualifications:****Experience:**  

10\+ years in SAP S/4HANA FIORI development, with recent projects focusing on SAP S/4HANA.
  
  

**Education:**  

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  
  

**Technical Proficiency:**  

Strong expertise in Fiori elements, UI5, CDS Views, SAP Gateway, BAS (Business Application Studio), Launchpad Configuration, Fiori Security \& Roles, Workflow/My Inbox Integration, RAP / CAP Development, BTP Services, DevOps / Git / CI\-CD, Performance Optimization.
  
  

**Project Exposure:**  

Experience in end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA Implementation, Migration, Rollout or Support projects.
  
Experience in greenfield or brownfield S/4HANA migration project
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Design, development, and optimization of SAP Fiori apps, leveraging SAPUI5 for front\-end development, and ensuring efficient integration with backend systems using OData services.
  
Create and manage advanced UI components and custom Fiori elements, ensuring they meet user requirements and provide a seamless user experience within the Fiori environment.
  
Configure and optimize the SAP Fiori Launchpad, SAP Build Work Zone, including managing tiles, roles, and groups, and ensuring efficient handling of Fiori application processes.
  
Implement and customize SAP S/4HANA solutions with a focus on Fiori, including the use of CDS Views, OData services, and AMDPs to enhance Fiori applications and ensure compatibility with S/4HANA features.
  
Identify and resolve issues in SAP Fiori and UI5 applications, enhance standard Fiori apps by optimizing OData services and improving overall application performance
  
ABAP Development Tools (ADT) for modern Fiori development practices, including version control and integration with SAP Fiori development processes.
  
Perform thorough code testing and quality assurance for Fiori applications, ensuring high\-quality standards and addressing any functional or performance issues.
  
Utilize strong problem\-solving skills to address and resolve complex issues encountered in Fiori app development and deployment, ensuring effective and timely solutions.
  
Continuous development of the UX/Fiori strategy, communication and coordination with functional departments and technical departments like IT\-security and BASIS.
  
Work closely with business analysts, functional consultants, and cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and ensure timely delivery of assigned tasks.
  
  

**Required Skills:**  

**Architecting and Collaboration:** Evaluate alternative solutions for business requirements/issues, present it to the stakeholders with pros and cons and get it implemented to give best business outcome
  
**Deep Knowledge:** Extensive experience with SAP Fiori design principles, architecture, and development using SAPUI5\.
  
**Custom Development:** Expertise in creating and customizing Fiori applications, including transactional, analytical, and factsheet apps.
  
**OData Expertise:** In\-depth knowledge of OData services and SAP Gateway for integrating Fiori apps with backend systems.
  
**Service Development:** Experience in creating, configuring, and managing OData services.
  
**Configuration:** Advanced skills in configuring the Fiori Launchpad, including setting up tiles, roles, and groups to meet business needs.
  
**Integration:** Familiarity with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for extending and integrating Fiori apps, if applicable.
  
**Complex Issue Resolution:** Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to Fiori applications and integrations.
  
**Technical Documentation:** Proficiency in creating detailed technical documentation, including design specifications, configuration guides, and user manuals
  
**Effective Communication:** Excellent communication skills for interacting with senior stakeholders, leading teams, and presenting solutions.
  
**Soft Skills:** Excellent problem\-solving and analytical abilities, ability to adapt to new technologies, ready to work in an agile development environment, Learn and educate the team with new technologies

title: Senior Associate - React
description:
### **Description**

  

The Senior Associate \- Front End Engineering is a hands\-on front\-end engineering role, equivalent in scope and expectations to a UK Intermediate Engineer. The role is responsible for building high\-quality user\-facing software solutions across the Consulting \& Technology estate.
  

The role provides strong squad\-level technical contribution across the React ecosystem, including TypeScript, component architecture, state management, automated front\-end testing, accessibility, performance, and integration with modern API\-driven services.
Working closely with architects, lead engineers, and senior engineers, the role helps translate technical direction into maintainable implementation, follows agreed engineering standards, and contributes to delivery quality through sound engineering practice.
This role is ideal for an experienced front\-end engineer who can operate independently on well\-defined work, contribute to technical discussions, support good engineering discipline, and deliver robust web applications in Agile engineering squads.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

***Front End Design \& Development**** Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality React and TypeScript applications aligned to agreed architecture and squad delivery priorities.
* Build reusable components, shared UI patterns, and design\-system\-aligned experiences that support consistency and maintainability.
* Contribute to client\-side implementation decisions including routing, state management, data fetching, forms, validation, error handling, and API integration.
* Write clean, maintainable, secure front\-end code following modern React patterns and agreed engineering standards.
* Work with UX/UI colleagues and Product Owners to deliver responsive, accessible, intuitive user experiences.

***Engineering Quality, Testing \& DevOps**** Create and maintain automated tests across unit, component, integration, and end\-to\-end layers using tools such as Jest / Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for front\-end applications, including build quality gates, test automation, static analysis, and deployment readiness.
* Support front\-end performance optimisation, observability, resilience, and maintainability across browser\-based applications.
* Apply secure coding practices across authentication flows, authorisation boundaries, API consumption, data handling, and dependency management.

***Technical Contribution \& Collaboration**** Operate as an experienced engineer within the squad, demonstrating good engineering discipline, ownership, and pragmatic problem\-solving.
* Participate in code reviews, pairing, design discussions, and constructive technical feedback with peers and junior developers.
* Contribute to shared front\-end standards, templates, component patterns, and engineering practices.
* Support onboarding activities where front\-end engineering input is required.

***Problem Solving \& Support**** Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve front\-end issues affecting delivery, quality, performance, or production stability.
* Work with Architects, Lead Engineers, Backend Engineers, QA, and Platform Engineers to resolve cross\-cutting technical problems.
* Contribute to improvements in shared front\-end libraries, frameworks, and platform components where required.

***Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement**** Work closely with Architects, Product Owners, Platform Engineers, Backend Engineers, and QA teams to ensure technical solutions meet business and user needs.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, contributing to planning, refinement, retrospectives, technical discovery, and continuous improvement.

***Continuous Improvement \& Innovation**** Identify practical opportunities to improve developer experience, front\-end quality, accessibility, performance, and delivery effectiveness.
* Keep up to date with relevant React, TypeScript, testing, and web platform developments.
* Contribute to continuous learning and engineering improvement across the squad and wider engineering community.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 ***Mandatory:**** 4\-5 SW experience and 3\-4 years AI/ML experience years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent capability demonstrated through delivery experience.
* Strong relevant experience delivering modern React and TypeScript applications in commercial or enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

***Knowledge, Skill and Ability:**** React ecosystem including hooks, component composition, routing, forms, and modern application architecture.
* TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and front\-end build tooling such as Vite or Webpack.
* State management and data\-fetching patterns such as Redux, Zustand, TanStack Query, or equivalent approaches.
* REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, authentication and authorisation flows, and secure client\-side integration patterns.
* Automated test tooling such as Jest / Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or equivalent.
* Accessibility standards such as WCAG, semantic HTML, browser compatibility, and front\-end performance optimisation.
* CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling, dependency management, and quality gates.

***Esential requirement (Non\- Negotiable)**** Strong hands\-on proficiency in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Experience implementing maintainable front\-end application structures, reusable components, and consistent UI patterns.
* Experience integrating front\-end applications with REST APIs and secure authentication/authorisation patterns.
* Good automated testing capability across unit, component, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, code quality tooling, and modern DevOps practices.
* Good understanding of accessibility, browser performance, responsive design, and user\-centred engineering.
* Secure coding practices and familiarity with OWASP principles.

***Nice to Have**** C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs
* SQL Server

  

### **About Davies**


We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  

  

We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation \& risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation \& change management.  

  

Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK \& the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20\-fold, investing heavily in research \& development, innovation \& automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.
